presentation.title: Adriano Andrade da Silva
presentation.openToWork: Open to Front-End and Full Stack roles with React and TypeScript
presentation.summary:
Software engineer with a strong focus on React, TypeScript, and frontend architecture. At UOL, I contributed to technical decisions and the evolution of applications on platforms with millions of monthly visits, working on component composition, state organization, and performance optimization. I collaborate with UX/UI to turn product needs into consistent, maintainable interfaces.

My experience also covers backend development with Node.js, APIs, and relational databases, connecting interfaces to business logic and data persistence. This full stack work includes replacing a third-party FAQ solution with an in-house system that reduced operating costs, and campaign automation tools adopted by the Operations team.

jobs.name: UOL
jobs.description:
Architecture & High-Impact Frontend
Progressed from feature delivery to owning system-wide architecture decisions and driving technical alignment across multiple business units. Architected and led the evolution of React/TypeScript applications on platforms handling millions of monthly visits — prioritizing scalability, maintainability, and performance. Defined componentization standards, global state contracts, and module structures for multidisciplinary teams.

AdTech & Programmatic Advertising
Integrated Google Ad Manager, Prebid, and proprietary Ad Server infrastructure, implementing bidding logic and ad inventory management across high-traffic portals. Ensured high availability and consistent performance under variable load.

Interfaces & Component Libraries
Built React/TypeScript interfaces with component libraries, following visual standards and collaborating with UX/UI (Figma, Adobe XD, Zeplin). Applied existing components to product needs, focusing on visual consistency.

Cross-team Collaboration
Worked closely with Data (Analytics), Backend teams from other business areas, and Infrastructure to deliver robust, integrated solutions and ensure alignment with company-wide technical strategies. Used Jira and Kanban board to manage team workflow, track priorities, and keep delivery pace visible.

Performance & Quality
Optimized critical applications with focus on code splitting, lazy loading, and Web Vitals. Implemented automated testing with Vitest, improving reliability and code coverage across large-scale codebases.

Automation & Internal Systems
Led development of UOL's new FAQ system, replacing a third-party solution and significantly cutting operational costs. Designed automation tooling for bulk ad campaign publishing, adopted by Operations teams.

items.name: Taskboard
items.problem: Centralize team workflows across companies, departments, and configurable Kanban boards.
items.solution: React/TypeScript interface with board navigation and tasks with assignees, priorities, comments, and activity history.
items.techDecisions: Frontend organized into components and hooks, using Vite and SCSS; shared contracts with the API.
items.outcome: Full-stack application with Fastify, Zod, Prisma, and PostgreSQL, JWT authentication, and organization-scoped authorization. Docker standardizes the environment and Vitest covers sensitive API flows.
items.demoNote: Demo with a browser-simulated API and data saved locally in localStorage.

items.name: Formula One Next
items.problem: Browse Formula 1 season data in a responsive interface.
items.solution: Next.js application consuming a custom API, separating data and presentation.
items.techDecisions: Per-route rendering with Next.js; Styled Components for styles and Bootstrap for the grid.
items.outcome: Published application with optimized load times, responsive layout, and a clear separation between data and presentation via server-side rendering.

items.name: Formula One Database
items.problem: Provide Formula 1 data to a frontend application through a custom API.
items.solution: Node.js and TypeScript REST API consumed by Formula One Next.
items.techDecisions: Express with separate routes, controllers, and data layers to organize responsibilities.
items.outcome: Production API consumed by Formula One Next, with low layer coupling, extensible structure for new season data, and full TypeScript contracts ensuring safe changes across all endpoints.
